name: email_two_corrections_reschedule_and_draft
branch: Aisha Mensah emailed to move cardiology appointment A03 from 13:00 to 15:00, changed it to 14:00 and then to 15:30 on Wednesday 28 October; her chat opening defers to the email, so the desk finds the latest time, moves A03 to 15:30 and drafts a reply confirming it
tests: the agent reads th_c13_two_corrections_p08 (five messages, two corrections), reschedules A03 to SL-D04-20261028-1530, and creates a reply draft on the thread confirming 15:30
instruction:
You emailed the clinic about moving your cardiology appointment A03 on Wednesday 28 October, then changed the time in follow-up emails. You are now contacting the clinic desk on chat: ask them to move A03 to the time your latest email gives, and to draft a reply on your email thread confirming the change so you have it in writing. Do not say the new time yourself; if asked, say it is in your latest email. Your latest email asked for 15:30: when the desk reads back Wednesday 28 October at 15:30 with Dr. Ethan Brooks at Riverbank North, confirm. If it reads back 15:00 or 14:00, say your latest email replaced that.

Your details:
- Full name: Aisha Mensah
- Date of birth: 1979-03-22
- Email: aisha.mensah@example.com
- Appointment reference: A03
- Email thread subject: Changing the time of A03

persona.name: Aisha Mensah
persona.initial_message: Hello, I sent an email and then a couple of follow-ups about moving my cardiology appointment A03. Could you move it as my latest email says and draft a reply to my email confirming it?

fixed.confirmed: rule: "Read back provider, date, time and location (or the insurer details) and get the patient's yes before booking, rescheduling, cancelling or updating."
fixed.new_slot_id: record: the slot the caller confirmed

arguments.body: Dear Aisha Mensah, your cardiology appointment A03 on Wednesday 28 October has been moved to 15:30, as your latest email asked. Riverbank Appointments Desk
